title: PII/sensitivity detection methodology codified as a reviewable gate artifact
context: The PII/sensitivity detection methodology must be repeatable and recorded so the mandatory license/PII/sensitivity reviewer can audit which checks ran and what fired. This codifies the direct-identifier heuristics, the quasi-identifier k>=5 check, the geo-precision threshold, and the sensitivity-list lookup into a committed gate artifact. Depends on csp-privacy-009 and the csp-policy-003 charter.
objective: Codify the PII/sensitivity detection methodology (direct-identifier heuristics, k>=5 quasi-identifier check, geo-precision threshold, sensitivity-list lookup) as a committed, reviewable gate artifact whose output records which checks ran and what fired.
acceptanceCriteria: Documents column-name + value heuristics for direct identifiers, the quasi-identifier k>=5 check, the geo-precision threshold (default coarsen beyond ~3 decimal places unless justified), and sensitivity-list lookup by resolved taxon
Any flag yields suppress/generalize; the methodology output (which checks ran, what fired) is committed per run
Artifact is structured for the License+PII reviewer to audit and sign off
Aligns with the fail-closed invariant and the no-PII-in-repo rule
output: docs/policy/pii-sensitivity-detection-methodology.md committed as the reviewable gate artifact.
